flow_name: Cognitive Validation to Active Coping for Quarter-system Burnout

stages.name: Emotional Validation
stages.description: Validate the patient's immediate distress regarding no breaks.

stages.name: Cognitive Reframing
stages.description: Gently challenge negative cognitive distortions surrounding no breaks.

stages.name: Micro-Actionable Stepping
